_comment: Per-model per-quant weights and architecture facts for VRAM estimation. FIELD OWNERSHIP: the offline Ollama tool (cmd/bestiary-ollama) owns weights_bytes, the per-row digest (the sha256 OCI manifest digest), the quant set, param_size, and source — it refreshes these from the Ollama registry on each run. Curation owns layers/kv_heads/head_dim (absent from the Ollama registry), context_window, base_ref, and the per-entry _comment — the tool PRESERVES these across a refresh (merge-on-refresh), never clobbering them. model_id is the models.dev catalog ID for joined models, or an 'ollama/<id>' namespace form for community models with no models.dev presence. VRAMBytes/VRAMContextTokens are computed and baked by codegen. Sorted by model_id (rows by quant) — deterministic.

models._comment: Plausible+documented: weights_bytes estimated from ollama.com/library/llama3.2 tags page size display (~2.0 GB Q4_K_M, ~3.2 GB Q8_0). Arch facts absent (exercises partial-VRAM path). model_id is the models.dev catalog ID 'llama-3.2-3b-instruct' so codegen joins this row. Refresh with offline tool for authoritative figures.

Research-sourced: arch facts from Meta-Llama-3.3-70B public model card (layers=80, kv_heads=8, head_dim=128, context_window=131072). weights_bytes from ollama.com/library/llama3.3/tags page (Q4_K_M ~42.5 GB, Q8_0 ~75 GB, F16 ~141 GB) as of 2026-06-09. model_id is the models.dev catalog ID 'llama-3.3-70b-instruct' so codegen joins this row onto the catalog.

Param-size-only entry (no curated weights): the models.dev catalog ID 'llama-3.3-8b-instruct' shares Family/Version/Modifier with the 70b instruct entry above, so without a curated param_size the two would wrong-merge into a single unsized llama@3.3{instruct} entity. Carrying param_size='8b' here splits it into the distinct llama@3.3#8b{instruct} entity. No authoritative GGUF weights figures are available for this catalog entry yet (it is not a standard Meta release), so rows is intentionally empty: ParamSize and Source are baked, but QuantVRAM stays nil until the offline tool supplies real weights. Refresh with the offline tool for VRAM figures.

Community finetune NOT in the models.dev catalog: kept under its Ollama-native ID ('ollama/dracarys2-llama-3-70b-instruct', a namespace/slash form — not a models.dev catalog ID) because no matching models.dev model ID exists, so it does NOT join during codegen — it awaits the offline Ollama tool's network-gated ID join. This entry exercises the codegen finetune-lineage inference path via base_ref (the base_ref field 'llama3:70b-instruct' genuinely uses colon-tag notation). weights_bytes are a plausible estimate for a 70B Q4_K_M model; arch facts copied from the base. Refresh with offline tool for authoritative figures.
